races.title: OLBG Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SPIRITS BAY often goes well fresh and looks a potential class angle in a wide-open renewal. He narrowly shades the vote over race-fit and unexposed Zarakerjack , while Faivoir would be interesting if supported from a slipping mark. SPIRITS BAY ZARAKERJACK (FR) FAIVOIR (FR)

races.title: CSP Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PRESLEY shaped with plenty of promise in a couple of bumpers last season, building on his debut effort despite his exuberance when second at Warwick in March. He rates a very bright prospect now hurdling for his top stable and shades preference over Merlin Allen , who was a very good third in an Aintree Grade 2 bumper himself in the spring. Moments Away and useful Flat performer Insanity are also respected. PRESLEY (IRE) MERLIN ALLEN (FR) MOMENTS AWAY (IRE)

races.title: Grahame Church Memorial Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: NAN'S CHOICE 's Grade 2 bumper success at Aintree on her first outing for Dan Skelton marks her down as one who could go a long way over hurdles. Princess Day and Connells Cross shaped with promise in the same Chepstow novice on hurdle debut last month and are likely to go well. Nicky Henderson point recruit Royal Response is one to monitor closely in the betting. NAN'S CHOICE (IRE) PRINCESS DAY (IRE) CONNELLS CROSS (IRE)

races.title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Lots with chances. MOON CHIME was in the process of running really well (still in front) when falling at the last in the Silver Trophy at Chepstow on his return and this winning stayer on the Flat is worth siding with on his first try over this 3m trip. Recent Ffos Las scorer Kilwaughter heads the list of dangers, although a good case can also be made for the likes of Bill Baxter , Splendid Fellow and Western Monkey in this fascinating handicap. The Jukebox Kid completes the shortlist. MOON CHIME KILWAUGHTER (IRE) BILL BAXTER (IRE)

races.title: Check Out The BetVictor Betbuilder Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PERCY DE COURCY looked a good prospect when scoring easily on his sole points run so is taken to make a winning start in this sphere now starting out for the all-conquering Skelton team. Spare The Voice was also successful on his only outing in points so could emerge as the main danger on his debut for Nick Scholfield ahead of Grand Teton and Coolnav who rate the pick of those with experience. PERCY DE COURCY SPARE THE VOICE (IRE) GRAND TETON (IRE)

races.title: BetVictor Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: No form to go on but lots of potential in this closing bumper and the market should reveal plenty. Dan Skelton's Doyen gelding NEWGROVE was an impressive winner on his only run in an Irish point in the spring and gets the nod over Geissler who hails from a yard with a good record in this event. Treble Three and Radiant Walk are also in excellent hands and need factoring in, too. NEWGROVE (IRE) GEISSLER (IRE) TREBLE THREE (IRE)
